name: zgeometry_weiler_output_selected_input_contour_to_polygon_set_a
description: zGeometry_Weiler::OutputSelectedInputContourToPolygonSetA copies the selected input contour into polygonSetA and appends its points to the clip output when clip mode bit 0 is enabled.
known_limits: realloc is provider behavior for large output point lists. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry Weiler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x468700 validates the clipMode bit gate, mode-based selection of contour A versus B, polygonSetA count/point span writes, pointDwordOffset calculation, optional realloc, memcpy, and point count update.
The native clip leaf smoke verifies the disabled no-op path and the enabled contour-A append path.
